<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:#070b16;color:#e8eef8;
 font-family:"Segoe UI","Microsoft JhengHei",system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans TC",sans-serif}
.wrap{max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 40px}
h1{font-size:25px;margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:.5px}
h2{font-size:16.5px;margin:0;padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #1e2a44;
 background:#0d1424;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0}
h3{font-size:14px;margin:18px 0 7px;color:#c7d4ea}
.sub{color:#8fa0bd;font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.6}
.card{background:#0f1729;border:1px solid #1e2a44;border-radius:10px;margin:0 0 16px;
 box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.card .body{padding:12px 14px}
.kpis{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin:0 0 14px}
.kpi{background:#0f1729;border:1px solid #1e2a44;border-radius:9px;padding:8px 12px;min-width:104px}
.kpi .k{font-size:10.5px;color:#7f90ad;letter-spacing:.6px;text-transform:uppercase}
.kpi .v{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;margin-top:2px}
.warn{background:#3a2410;border:1px solid #a0620f;color:#fbc06a;border-radius:9px;
 padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 13px}
.ok{background:#0f2a1a;border:1px solid #2c7a4b;color:#7fe0a3;border-radius:9px;
 padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;margin:0 0 13px}
.bar-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 14px;
 background:#0f1729;border:1px solid #1e2a44;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px}
select{background:#16203a;color:#e8eef8;border:1px solid #2a3a5c;border-radius:7px;
 padding:7px 10px;font-size:14px;font-family:inherit}
.filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:0 0 10px}
button{background:#16203a;color:#c7d4ea;border:1px solid #2a3a5c;border-radius:7px;
 padding:6px 11px;font-size:12.5px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
button:hover{background:#1d2a49}
button:disabled{opacity:.40;cursor:default}
button.on{background:#2b6cb0;border-color:#4a90d9;color:#fff;font-weight:700}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px}
th,td{padding:5px 6px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid #17203311}
th{color:#8296b4;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;text-align:right;background:#0d1424}
td.l,th.l{text-align:left}
tr:hover td{background:#141d33}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.bar{height:9px;border-radius:5px;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle}
.pos{color:#4ade80}.neg{color:#f87171}
.note{color:#7f90ad;font-size:11.5px;margin-top:9px;line-height:1.65}
#tip{position:fixed;pointer-events:none;display:none;background:#0b1220ee;border:1px solid #35507e;
 border-radius:8px;padding:9px 11px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;z-index:99;max-width:300px;
 box-shadow:0 6px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
#tip b{color:#9fd4ff}
footer{color:#5f708c;font-size:11.5px;margin-top:18px;line-height:1.7}
code{background:#16203a;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:11.5px}
.pt{cursor:pointer}
.pt:hover circle{stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2.5}
.pane{display:none}
.pane.on{display:block}
</style>
